name: mypaios
description: My Personal AI OS — local-first chat, agents, video analysis, research & email triage on your own machine

paragraphs: MyPaiOS is a self-hosted, local-first AI workspace — one app that gives you the chat / agents / research / documents experience of the big hosted assistants, running entirely on your own hardware, against your own models, with your own data. The assistant you talk to is Pi (the π mark). No telemetry, no subscription, no cloud dependency for core function.
Built in the spirit of Swarajya — self-rule — inspired by Chhatrapati Shivaji Maharaj, who built sovereignty from first principles. Your machine, your models, your data, your rule.
MyPaiOS is not affiliated with Kwaai pAI-OS (paios.org), aurintex paiOS, or PayOS.
features: Chat -- chat with any local model or API; adding them is super simple.
vLLM · llama.cpp · Ollama · OpenRouter · OpenAI · GitHub Copilot
Agent -- hand Pi tools and let it run the whole task itself.
built on opencode · MCP · web · files · shell · skills · memory
Cookbook -- scans your hardware, recommends models, click to download and serve — easy!

On first setup, MyPaiOS creates an admin account (admin unless PAIOSADMINUSER is set) and prints a temporary password in the terminal.
Use that for the first login, then change it in Settings.
